items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever play at the Bulls Club? Ethan Dinell and the one? No. Um... Once or twice.

ctx.x: No. He started playing soprano when he went to California. Yeah. When he moved out there.

And he could... He told me he mainly read clarinet parts when he was a big fan. When he was with King Oliver. Yeah. That's right. Stuff like that. He was playing a lot of alto. What's that? Did you ever play at the Bulls Club? Ethan Dinell and the one? No. Um... Once or twice.

Um... Um... I'm missing out with this piano player's name. He started playing for churches. I can't remember his name. And then that's when Alvin Alcorn had just started. Because he was in that band. This was a piano player? Uh... He was a piano player at his band. Uh-huh. And he used to hire other piano players. And he started in front of them. Uh-huh. But there weren't much money in those days. It didn't make it different anyway. Down the quarter, down the air. Yeah.
